headline: Senior Product and Systems Engineer · AI/SI agentic workflows
summary: Senior software engineer with 9+ years shipping web products. Nearly eight of them were at Oneflow, a contract management platform, where I grew from JavaScript developer to founding the Integration Team, leading an engineering team and moving a live codebase to TypeScript. Since December 2024 I have worked independently on AI/SI product and systems engineering for agentic workflows. Master's degrees in Computer Science and Operations Research. Available now and can start within two weeks of an offer, for a senior fullstack, product or Forward Deployed Engineer role.

roles.title: Independent AI/SI product and systems engineering (agentic workflows)

ensembly_bullets: a Rust service that gives several coding-agent tools (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Cursor, Claude Code) one shared SQLite ledger and one approval flow. Agents propose; one single-writer SQLite ledger authorizes, claims and completes, with idempotent retries and a one-command installer per harness.

Append-only record layer with event time, hybrid logical clocks, versioned envelopes and writer provenance; CRDT episodic memory that advises but never decides; pulse-pack memory sync between hosts; a read-only MCP server.
evalbench and a retrieval benchmark measure memory before it is trusted; a semi-decision model proposes and waits for my confirmation, so it suggests and I decide.
kanithanj: kanithanj (collab-finder): a local-first Tauri, Rust and React desktop app that runs an agentic workflow over listings and documents. Typed Rust checks (fit, cost, rate) run before any model call; a human-in-the-loop step approves changes and spend. 1.0.0 in Aug 2026, now 1.3.0; https://kanithanj-ai.vercel.app. Kanithanj began as a private desktop app he uses daily and is now heading to public use once fully actualized.
